paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role supporting Electronic Markets. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'd like to work on the finance side of a business that runs on market data and trading workflows.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation that I turned into clear recommendations for stakeholders. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region.

That background fits a business partner role: building the plan, tracking what moved against it, and explaining why to the people running the business. I'm comfortable with large data sets and with automating reporting. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
